author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In this live stream excerpt, Adam Savage answers questions from Tested members about managing productivity guilt, setting realistic expectations for a day's work, and the reality that we're all going to die with an unfinished to-do list. Plus, Adam discusses his experience with meditation in the creative process, strategies for hunting at yard sales, and practical advice on buying used CNC machines for your shop. Big thanks to BThings, TheElderCryptid, philredbeard and tikigodstudios, whom we thank for their questions and support!
